| num_assets | 131 (Kraken FAQ, 2026-10-25; 100 stocks, 27 ETFs, 4 specialist) |

*In plain English: xStocks are tokens backed one-for-one by US stocks and ETFs.*

xStocks are stock and ETF tokens issued by Backed Assets (JE) Limited, backed 1:1 by the underlying asset. They launched on Bybit, Kraken and [[concepts/glossary#solana|Solana]] DeFi on 30 June 2025 ([PR Newswire](https://www.prnewswire.com/news-releases/backeds-xstocks-go-live-today-on-bybit-kraken-and-solana-defi-302494374.html)).

On 2 December 2025 Kraken announced it **agreed to acquire** Backed Finance AG ([Kraken](https://blog.kraken.com/news/backed-acquisition); [Business Wire](https://www.businesswire.com/news/home/20251202666578/en/Kraken-to-Acquire-Backed-Accelerating-xStocks-Expansion-and-Unlocking-Global-Demand-for-Tokenized-Equities)); completion status not confirmed here.

At that date xStocks offered more than 60 assets, live on Solana and [[concepts/glossary#ethereum|Ethereum]]. xStocks are not available in the US ([Kraken press release](https://www.payward.com/press-release/kraken-acquires-backed-xstocks-expansion)). Kraken's xStocks FAQ now lists 131 assets (100 stocks, 27 ETFs, 4 specialist assets) on Solana, Ethereum, TON and Ink, for eligible non-US clients in 110+ countries; not the US, Canada, the UK or Australia ([Kraken FAQ](https://support.kraken.com/articles/xstocks-faq)).

A figure of 1,100 assets advertised elsewhere ([Zerion](https://zerion.io/blog/best-tokenized-stock-platforms/), secondary) is unverified and not used.

Corporate actions use a [[concepts/glossary#multiplier|multiplier]] ([xStocks docs](https://docs.xstocks.fi/developers/multipliers)): dividends are reinvested net of withholding and raise the multiplier ([xStocks docs](https://docs.xstocks.fi/docs/dividends-and-stock-splits)); holders get no voting rights ([Kraken FAQ](https://support.kraken.com/articles/xstocks-faq)); see [[topics/corporate-actions-and-dividends|corporate actions]]; exchange integration and API: [integration](https://docs.xstocks.fi/docs/exchange-integration), [OpenAPI](https://docs.xstocks.fi/apis/openapi.md).

## What this means for holders
- You hold a 1:1-backed [[concepts/glossary#wrapper|wrapper]] certificate issued by Backed Assets (Jersey), not the share itself ([Kraken FAQ](https://support.kraken.com/articles/xstocks-faq)).
- Dividends and splits are reflected by adjusting the token's [[concepts/glossary#multiplier|multiplier]] ([xStocks docs](https://docs.xstocks.fi/docs/dividends-and-stock-splits)).
- Not offered in the US, Canada, the UK or Australia ([Kraken FAQ](https://support.kraken.com/articles/xstocks-faq)).
- Tokens can be withdrawn to a self-custody [[concepts/glossary#wallet|wallet]] ([PR Newswire](https://www.prnewswire.com/news-releases/backeds-xstocks-go-live-today-on-bybit-kraken-and-solana-defi-302494374.html)).

*Reference information only, not investment advice.*

# Bullish Exchange
URL: https://edstokenizedsecuritiesrails.com/platforms-venues/bullish
description: In plain English: Bullish runs a crypto exchange in Gibraltar where its own shares now trade as tokens that are real, registered shares.
type: venue
jurisdiction: Gibraltar
chain: unknown
status: live (first trades 2026-08-12)
last_updated: 2026-10-27
last_checked: 2026-10-27

> [!info] At a glance
> **Type:** venue  
> **Jurisdiction:** Gibraltar  
> **Chain:** unknown  
> **Status:** live (first trades 2026-08-12)  
> **Last updated:** 2026-10-27  

| Field | Value |
|---|---|
| name | Bullish Exchange |
| jurisdiction | Gibraltar |
| product_name | Tokenized BLSH shares |
| structure | Issuer-sponsored shares recorded at the registry level |
| chains | unknown |
| who_can_buy | unknown |
| num_assets | 1 (BLSH) at launch |

*In plain English: Bullish runs a crypto exchange in Gibraltar where its own shares now trade as tokens that are real, registered shares.*

On 12 Aug 2026 market participants traded Bullish's tokenized BLSH shares on Bullish Exchange, settled against a USD stablecoin; Bullish says this was the first tokenized equity traded on a Gibraltar Financial Services Commission (GFSC) regulated digital asset exchange ([Bullish](https://investors.bullish.com/news-releases/news-release-details/bullish-launches-tokenized-equity-trading)). Bullish says it received GFSC approval for tokenized securities trading in June 2026 (not confirmed on a GFSC page), and the registry side depends on its pending acquisition of Equiniti ([Bullish](https://investors.bullish.com/news-releases/news-release-details/bullish-launches-tokenized-equity-trading)).

On 24 Sep 2026 Bullish and Equiniti formed the [[concepts/issuer-sponsored-token-coalition|Issuer Sponsored Token Coalition]] to set standards for [[concepts/glossary#issuer-sponsored-token|issuer-sponsored tokens]]. Bullish expects its \$4.2B Equiniti acquisition, agreed in May 2026, to close in January 2027 ([Bullish](https://www.bullish.com/us/news-insights/leading-market-infrastructure-firms-form-coalition-to-advance-issuer-sponsored-tokenized-securities)).

## What this means for holders
- The tokens are issuer-sponsored and recorded at the share registry, so holders own shares directly, not a wrapper or derivative ([Bullish](https://investors.bullish.com/news-releases/news-release-details/bullish-launches-tokenized-equity-trading)).
- Only BLSH trades this way so far; trading runs 24/7 with near-instant settlement ([Bullish](https://investors.bullish.com/news-releases/news-release-details/bullish-launches-tokenized-equity-trading)).

*Reference information only, not investment advice.*

# Kraken
URL: https://edstokenizedsecuritiesrails.com/platforms-venues/kraken

*In plain English: Kraken is a crypto exchange that lists xStocks for trading.*

Kraken listed xStocks on 30 June 2025 with 24/5 trading and withdrawals ([PR Newswire](https://www.prnewswire.com/news-releases/backeds-xstocks-go-live-today-on-bybit-kraken-and-solana-defi-302494374.html)).

On 18 Aug 2026 Kraken opened 7,000+ US-listed stocks to eligible EEA customers under MiFID II through Payward Europe Digital Solutions (CY) Limited, next to 700+ xStocks in the same account ([Kraken](https://blog.kraken.com/product/equities/announcing-us-listed-stock-trading-for-eea-customers)). EEA clients must pass a questionnaire and can trade xStocks only with fiat via Convert, not on Pro order books or the API ([Kraken support](https://support.kraken.com/articles/xstocks-availability)).

Kraken said on 22 Oct 2026 that its xStocks lineup exceeds 1,000 tokenized instruments ([The Defiant](https://thedefiant.io/news/cefi/kraken-says-its-xstocks-lineup-now-exceeds-1-000), news; not yet confirmed on a Kraken page).

## What this means for holders
- Kraken lists xStocks, so what you hold is an xStock with Backed's terms: see [[issuers/xstocks-backed|xStocks]].
- Trading is 24/5 and tokens can be withdrawn to a self-custody [[concepts/glossary#wallet|wallet]] ([PR Newswire](https://www.prnewswire.com/news-releases/backeds-xstocks-go-live-today-on-bybit-kraken-and-solana-defi-302494374.html)).

*Reference information only, not investment advice.*

# Nasdaq tokenized securities rule
URL: https://edstokenizedsecuritiesrails.com/platforms-venues/nasdaq-tokenized-securities
description: In plain English: Nasdaq can now trade tokenized versions of the same stocks it already lists, settled through DTC's pilot.
type: venue
jurisdiction: United States
chain: unknown
status: rule approved by SEC 2026-03-18
last_updated: 2026-10-17
last_checked: 2026-10-17

> [!info] At a glance
> **Type:** venue  
> **Jurisdiction:** United States  
> **Chain:** unknown  
> **Status:** rule approved by SEC 2026-03-18  
> **Last updated:** 2026-10-17  

| Field | Value |
|---|---|
| name | Nasdaq tokenized securities rule |
| jurisdiction | United States |
| product_name | SR-NASDAQ-2025-072 |
| structure | Same security, tokenized form; same CUSIP/ticker/rights, same order book |
| chains | unknown |
| who_can_buy | DTC Pilot eligible participants |
| num_assets | Russell 1000 constituents + certain ETPs |

*In plain English: Nasdaq can now trade tokenized versions of the same stocks it already lists, settled through DTC's pilot.*

The SEC approved Nasdaq's rule on 18 March 2026, enabling tokenized trading during [[concepts/glossary#dtc|DTC]]'s tokenization pilot ([SEC](https://www.sec.gov/files/rules/sro/nasdaq/2026/34-105047.pdf)).

Original notice: [SEC Rel. 34-103989](https://www.sec.gov/files/rules/sro/nasdaq/2025/34-103989.pdf). The approval keeps tokenized shares on the same book with the same priority, [[concepts/glossary#cusip|CUSIP]], symbol and rights, settling through the DTC pilot; see [[concepts/post-trade-reg-nms-model|post-trade / Reg NMS model]].

On 10 Sep 2026 Nasdaq agreed to invest \$100M in Payward, Kraken's parent, to build Nasdaq Equity Tokens (NETs) linked to xStocks; NETs are expected in Q2 2027 ([Nasdaq](https://www.nasdaq.com/press-release/nasdaq-deepens-relationship-payward-advance-tokenized-equities-and-always)).

## What this means for holders
- A tokenized share on Nasdaq trades on the same order book, with the same [[concepts/glossary#cusip|CUSIP]], symbol and shareholder rights as the regular share ([SEC](https://www.sec.gov/files/rules/sro/nasdaq/2026/34-105047.pdf)).
- Settlement runs through the [[concepts/glossary#dtc|DTC]] tokenization pilot, so the token is an entitlement recorded via DTC ([SEC](https://www.sec.gov/files/rules/sro/nasdaq/2026/34-105047.pdf)).

*Reference information only, not investment advice.*

## Sources
Public originals for the facts on this page.

- <https://www.govinfo.gov/content/pkg/FR-2026-03-23/html/2026-05563.htm>
- <https://www.reuters.com/legal/government/nasdaq-receives-sec-nod-trading-tokenized-securities-2026-03-18/>
- <https://www.sec.gov/files/rules/sro/nasdaq/2025/34-103989.pdf>

*In plain English: NYSE has a rule, like Nasdaq's, to trade tokenized versions of listed stocks through DTC's pilot.*

NYSE filed SR-NYSE-2026-17 (Rel. 34-105260), an immediately effective rule along the lines of Nasdaq's and tied to the [[concepts/glossary#dtc|DTC]] pilot ([NYSE](https://www.nyse.com/publicdocs/nyse/markets/nyse/rule-filings/sec-approvals/2026/%28SR-NYSE-2026-17%29_34-105260.pdf)).

Separately, ICE announced on 19 Jan 2026 that NYSE is developing a platform for 24/7 trading of tokenized equities and [[concepts/glossary#etf|ETFs]] with instant settlement and [[concepts/glossary#stablecoin|stablecoin]] funding, subject to approval and DTC readiness ([ICE](https://ir.theice.com/press/news-details/2026/The-New-York-Stock-Exchange-Develops-Tokenized-Securities-Platform/)).

No technical spec or launch date was found.

## What this means for holders
- NYSE's rule SR-NYSE-2026-17 follows Nasdaq's and is tied to the [[concepts/glossary#dtc|DTC]] pilot ([NYSE](https://www.nyse.com/publicdocs/nyse/markets/nyse/rule-filings/sec-approvals/2026/%28SR-NYSE-2026-17%29_34-105260.pdf)).
- The planned 24/7 tokenized platform is subject to regulatory approval, so holders cannot use it yet ([ICE](https://ir.theice.com/press/news-details/2026/The-New-York-Stock-Exchange-Develops-Tokenized-Securities-Platform/)).

*Reference information only, not investment advice.*

# OKXICE TSV
URL: https://edstokenizedsecuritiesrails.com/platforms-venues/okxice-tsv
description: In plain English: OKXICE is the first onchain venue to publish plans under the SEC's Innovation Exemption, using Uniswap pools.
type: venue
jurisdiction: United States (TSV Exemption)
chain: unknown
status: TSV notice published 2026-10-04
last_updated: 2026-10-29
last_checked: 2026-10-29

> [!info] At a glance
> **Type:** venue  
> **Jurisdiction:** United States (TSV Exemption)  
> **Chain:** unknown  
> **Status:** TSV notice published 2026-10-04  
> **Last updated:** 2026-10-29  

| Field | Value |
|---|---|
| name | OKXICE TSV |
| jurisdiction | United States (TSV Exemption) |
| product_name | Tokenized Securities Venue |
| structure | Permissioned AMM (Uniswap v4 hook) |
| chains | unknown |
| who_can_buy | Holders of access soulbound tokens; U.S. person conditions per order |
| num_assets | 63 symbols listed in notice |

*In plain English: OKXICE is the first onchain venue to publish plans under the SEC's Innovation Exemption, using Uniswap pools.*

The first public [[concepts/glossary#tsv|TSV]] notice under the [[concepts/innovation-exemption|Innovation Exemption]], dated 4 Oct 2026 ([OKXICE notice](https://www.okx.com/cdn/assets/files/2610/798CC1267CB56FB2.pdf)). Design per the notice: Uniswap v4 pools with an OKXICE TSV hook, access via soulbound tokens, pairs against USDC/USDG/USDT, no order book and no custody; it describes admin-key governance.

The notice lists 63 symbols for 62 companies, since Alphabet has two share classes (GOOG and GOOGL) (counted from the [OKXICE notice, 4 Oct](https://www.okx.com/cdn/assets/files/2610/798CC1267CB56FB2.pdf), raw/04). Cerebras is not among them; OKXICE's own notices list it as an objector (see below). Coverage: [Ledger Insights](https://www.ledgerinsights.com/ice-okx-venture-plans-trading-of-tokenized-us-stocks-via-uniswap-pools/), [Crypto Briefing](https://cryptobriefing.com/okx-ice-uniswap-v4-hooks-tokenized-stocks/) (news).

## Issuer objections
OKXICE's public notice of 28 Oct 2026 lists **38** issuers that objected, up from 22 on 23 Oct. New since 23 Oct: IBM, IonQ, Oracle, Intel, JPMorgan, AMD, Applied Materials, Coca-Cola, Adobe, Dell, Sandisk, Eli Lilly, Carnival, Arcos Dorados, Walmart and Cigna. The notice still gives no trading start date ([OKXICE notice, 28 Oct](https://www.okx.com/cdn/assets/okfe/web3-activities/okxicetsv/notices/OKXICE_Tokenized_Securities_Venue_Public_Notice_26.10.28.pdf), raw/154).

OKXICE's public notice of 23 Oct 2026 lists **22** issuers that objected: Cerebras (CBRS), AppLovin, Applied Digital, Rocket Lab, CoreWeave, Verizon, Applied Optoelectronics, Broadcom, UnitedHealth, Goldman Sachs, Microsoft, Qualcomm, Caterpillar, McDonald's, Western Digital, Alphabet (GOOG/GOOGL), Arm, Wells Fargo, Moderna, Cisco, Intuit and Marvell ([OKXICE notice, 23 Oct](https://www.okx.com/cdn/assets/okfe/web3-activities/okxicetsv/notices/OKXICE_Tokenized_Securities_Venue_Public_Notice_26.10.23.pdf)).

The first 16 were already on its 19 Oct notice; Arm, Wells Fargo, Moderna, Cisco, Intuit and Marvell are new ([OKXICE notice, 19 Oct](https://www.okx.com/cdn/assets/okfe/web3-activities/okxicetsv/notices/OKXICE_Tokenized_Securities_Venue_Public_Notice_26.10.19.pdf)). Wells Fargo and Arm were not on the 4 Oct list, so not every objection removes a listed stock (raw/04; raw/106). CNBC's 21 Oct count of 16 matches the 19 Oct notice ([CNBC](https://www.cnbc.com/2026/10/21/tokenized-stocks-us-companies-object.html), news).

Cerebras appears as an objector even though it was not among the 63 symbols in the 4 Oct notice; neither notice says why (possibly an objection filed ahead of a listing; unverified). Under the [[concepts/innovation-exemption|Innovation Exemption]] the venue must notify each issuer and wait 30 days after receipt before trading ([CNBC](https://www.cnbc.com/2026/10/21/tokenized-stocks-us-companies-object.html)). Per Nasdaq's issuer FAQ, objections go directly to the venue that sent the notice and count only for that venue; there is no blanket opt-out across all TSVs ([Nasdaq FAQ](https://www.nasdaq.com/docs/listings/faq-sec-innovation-exemption), raw/156).

## What this means for holders
- OKXICE is a [[concepts/glossary#tsv|TSV]] under the [[concepts/glossary#innovation-exemption|Innovation Exemption]]: access is controlled through non-transferable access tokens, and trading pairs are [[concepts/glossary#stablecoin|stablecoins]] (USDC, USDG, USDT) ([OKX](https://www.okx.com/cdn/assets/files/2610/798CC1267CB56FB2.pdf)).
- The venue does not hold your tokens ([OKX](https://www.okx.com/cdn/assets/files/2610/798CC1267CB56FB2.pdf)).
- Issuers can object to third-party tokens of their stock: 38 had objected by 28 Oct 2026, which can keep those stocks off the venue ([OKXICE notice](https://www.okx.com/cdn/assets/okfe/web3-activities/okxicetsv/notices/OKXICE_Tokenized_Securities_Venue_Public_Notice_26.10.28.pdf)).

*Reference information only, not investment advice.*

## Sources
Public originals for the facts on this page.

- <https://didalabs.com/tokenized-stock-objection/>
- <https://www.ledgerinsights.com/ice-okx-venture-plans-trading-of-tokenized-us-stocks-via-uniswap-pools/>
- <https://cryptobriefing.com/okx-ice-uniswap-v4-hooks-tokenized-stocks/>
- <https://www.cnbc.com/2026/10/21/tokenized-stocks-us-companies-object.html>
- <https://www.sec.gov/files/rules/exorders/2026/34-106402.pdf>
- <https://www.nasdaq.com/docs/listings/faq-sec-innovation-exemption>

*Last checked 2026-10-29. Headline fields only; `unknown` means not yet verified from a source.*

URL: https://edstokenizedsecuritiesrails.com/infrastructure/chainlink-equity-feeds

| Field | Value |
|---|---|
| name | Chainlink tokenized equity feeds |

| product_name | Tokenized Equity Feeds; Data Streams |
| structure | Oracle |
| chains | unknown |
| who_can_buy | n/a |
| num_assets | unknown |

*In plain English: Chainlink supplies stock prices to blockchains so apps can value stock tokens, including outside market hours.*

Feeds combine the underlying 24/5 equity price with the issuer's [[concepts/glossary#multiplier|multiplier]] and respect issuer-controlled oracle pauses; issuer-specific pages exist for Coinbase [[concepts/glossary#b20|B20]] and Robinhood ([Chainlink](https://docs.chain.link/data-feeds/tokenized-equity-feeds)).

Data Streams price regular, extended and overnight sessions with market-status flags and staleness checks ([Chainlink](https://docs.chain.link/data-streams/rwa-streams/24-5-us-equities-user-guide)). For splits: pause the feed, stage the new multiplier, unpause; the issuer coordinates timing and Chainlink provides no corporate-action calendar ([Chainlink](https://docs.chain.link/data-streams/tokenized-asset-streams/handling-stock-splits)).

# DTCC Tokenization Service (DTS)
URL: https://edstokenizedsecuritiesrails.com/infrastructure/dtcc-tokenization-pilot
description: In plain English: DTC, the US central securities depository, is testing tokenized versions of shares it already holds.
type: infrastructure
jurisdiction: United States
chain: At launch: Canton Network, Besu (DTCC private network); 2027: Stellar, Arc (Circle)
status: pilot (SEC no-action letter 2025-12-11)
last_updated: 2026-10-28
last_checked: 2026-10-28

> [!info] At a glance
> **Type:** infrastructure  
> **Jurisdiction:** United States  
> **Chain:** At launch: Canton Network, Besu (DTCC private network); 2027: Stellar, Arc (Circle)  
> **Status:** pilot (SEC no-action letter 2025-12-11)  
> **Last updated:** 2026-10-28  

| Field | Value |
|---|---|
| name | DTCC Tokenization Service (DTS) |
| jurisdiction | United States |
| product_name | DTCC Tokenization Service (DTS; Tokenized Entitlements) |
| structure | Security entitlements recorded on DLT |
| chains | At launch: Canton Network, Besu (DTCC private network); 2027: Stellar, Arc (Circle) |
| who_can_buy | DTC participants (20 signed at launch, 28 Oct 2026) |
| num_assets | 34 securities at launch (~\$30T eligible): select Russell 1000 equities, ETFs, Treasuries |

*In plain English: DTC, the US central securities depository, is testing tokenized versions of shares it already holds.*

DTC operates a tokenization pilot under a 11 Dec 2025 SEC no-action letter ([SEC](https://www.sec.gov/files/rules/sro/nasdaq/2026/34-105047.pdf)); 24X Exchange filed rules referencing it ([SEC](https://www.sec.gov/rules-regulations/self-regulatory-organization-rulemaking/sr-24x-2026-20)).

## DTC no-action letter (11 Dec 2025)
Staff relief lets DTC participants record security entitlements on [[concepts/glossary#dlt|DLT]] ("Tokenized Entitlements") for Russell 1000 stocks, major-index [[concepts/glossary#etf|ETFs]] and Treasuries; tokens have no collateral or settlement value for Net Debit Cap / Collateral Monitor ([SEC NAL](https://www.sec.gov/files/tm/no-action/dtc-nal-121125.pdf); [Mayer Brown](https://www.mayerbrown.com/-/media/files/perspectives-events/publications/2025/12/sec-staff-no-action-relief-for-dtc-pilot-provides-a-pathway-for-tokenized-securities.pdf)). The letter is withdrawn three years from the date DTC launches the service ([SEC NAL](https://www.sec.gov/files/tm/no-action/dtc-nal-121125.pdf)).
## Live (28 Oct 2026)
DTC launched the DTCC Tokenization Service (DTS) on 28 Oct 2026 ([DTCC](https://www.dtcc.com/press-releases/2026/dtcc-tokenization-service-goes-live)). Tokenized security entitlements convert between traditional and tokenized form and go to users' wallets of choice, keeping the ownership rights, investor protections and economic entitlements of the traditional securities ([DTCC](https://www.dtcc.com/press-releases/2026/dtcc-tokenization-service-goes-live)).

- **Participants:** 20 DTC participants have signed agreements: Alpaca, Apex Clearing Corporation, Barclays, Bank of America, BNP Paribas, Brown Brothers Harriman, Citadel Securities, Citi, Clear Street, DriveWealth, Edward Jones, Fidelity Investments, Interchange Clearing, J.P. Morgan, Marex, Mirae Asset Securities (USA) Inc., Morgan Stanley, State Street, UBS and Velocity Capital LLC. More will be onboarded on a rolling basis ([DTCC](https://www.dtcc.com/press-releases/2026/dtcc-tokenization-service-goes-live)).
  - Participant Interchange Clearing runs execution, clearing and custody on one real-time platform with direct DTC and NSCC links ([Interchange](https://www.interchange.com/blog/interchange-clearing-to-access-the-dtcc-tokenization-service)).
- **Networks:** Canton Network and DTCC's private Besu network today, with more networks in 2027 ([DTCC](https://www.dtcc.com/press-releases/2026/dtcc-tokenization-service-goes-live)).
- **Ecosystem:** collaborators and partners include BitGo Bank & Trust, Blockdaemon, Broadridge, DFNS, DRW, Fireblocks, HIFI, Kaleido, Matter Labs, [[issuers/ondo-global-markets|Ondo]], Prometheum Capital, Talos, Taurus, Temple Digital Group, Tradeweb, Transcend and Virtu ([DTCC](https://www.dtcc.com/press-releases/2026/dtcc-tokenization-service-goes-live)).
- **Design input:** more than 150 firms in the DTC Digital Assets Solutions Industry Working Group ([DTCC](https://www.dtcc.com/press-releases/2026/dtcc-tokenization-service-goes-live)).
- **Scale:** DTC has more than \$114T in assets under custody ([DTCC](https://www.dtcc.com/press-releases/2026/dtcc-tokenization-service-goes-live)).

Scope at launch follows the Day 1 tear sheet below (raw/104).

## Progress
DTCC said the service was designed with feedback from more than 50 firms, with limited production trades planned for July 2026 and launch in October 2026 ([DTCC](https://www.dtcc.com/press-releases/2026/dtcc-advances-development-of-new-tokenization-service)). About 40 firms took part in live production trades; the 28 Oct go-live release says "more than 30 firms" completed the initial limited-production trades ([DTCC](https://www.dtcc.com/digital-assets/tokenization/live-production-trades); [DTCC press](https://www.dtcc.com/news/2026/july/15/dtcc-turns-tokenization-into-reality)).

On 23 Oct 2026 DTCC posted a Day 1 product tear sheet and an online user guide to its Learning Center ([DTCC tear sheet](https://dtcclearning.com/documents/dtcc-digital-assets/digital-asset-solutions/tokenization-service/5699-dtcc-tokenization-service-product-tear-sheet-and-high-level-roadmap/file.html)).

Before launch, no go-live date was public; The Block (8 Oct 2026) reported launch was expected that month ([The Block](https://www.theblock.co/newsletters/tokenization-briefing/2026-10-08-dtcc-brings-tokenization-us-markets-417839), secondary).

## Scope at launch (Oct 2026)
DTCC's Day 1 tear sheet (23 Oct 2026) says **34** securities are available to tokenize at launch ([DTCC tear sheet](https://dtcclearning.com/documents/dtcc-digital-assets/digital-asset-solutions/tokenization-service/5699-dtcc-tokenization-service-product-tear-sheet-and-high-level-roadmap/file.html)); its earlier at-a-glance sheet said 25 ([DTCC](https://communications.dtcc.com/rs/669-QIL-921/images/DTCC%20Tokenization%20Service%20At-a-Glance.pdf)), and DTCC does not explain the change.

Other launch terms in the at-a-glance sheet, unchanged in the tear sheet:  about \$30T eligible, backed 1:1 by securities held at DTC, same [[concepts/glossary#cusip|CUSIP]] and the same rights and investor protections as book-entry securities, and 24/7 peer-to-peer transfers between DTC-registered [[concepts/glossary#wallet|wallets]] on the same chain ([DTCC](https://communications.dtcc.com/rs/669-QIL-921/images/DTCC%20Tokenization%20Service%20At-a-Glance.pdf)).

Live at launch: Canton Network (CIP-56) and Besu, DTCC's private network ([[concepts/glossary#erc-20|ERC-20]]); Stellar and Circle's Arc are anticipated in 2027 ([DTCC](https://communications.dtcc.com/rs/669-QIL-921/images/DTCC%20Tokenization%20Service%20At-a-Glance.pdf)). Eligible assets start with select large-cap Russell 1000 equities, select ETFs and a select set of Treasury bills, notes and bonds ([DTCC](https://communications.dtcc.com/rs/669-QIL-921/images/DTCC%20Tokenization%20Service%20At-a-Glance.pdf)).

Conversion orders run 2 a.m.-6 p.m. ET on business days, targeting 15 minutes or less; tokens carry transfer restrictions; official books and records stay with DTC; Treasury distributions and maturities pay in fiat to participants' traditional accounts ([DTCC](https://communications.dtcc.com/rs/669-QIL-921/images/DTCC%20Tokenization%20Service%20At-a-Glance.pdf)).

Roadmap for 2027 and beyond (indicative): equity/ETF corporate actions, a consolidated stock record, on-chain [[concepts/glossary#netting|netting]] and digital cash ([DTCC](https://communications.dtcc.com/rs/669-QIL-921/images/DTCC%20Tokenization%20Service%20At-a-Glance.pdf)). Coverage: [Crypto Briefing](https://cryptobriefing.com/dtcc-tokenization-service-launch-october/) (news).

Firm counts differ by source and stage: more than 50 firms gave design feedback and about 40 took part in live production trades (DTCC); Crypto Briefing's "more than 30" is secondary and is not used here.

## DRS modernization (SR-DTC-2026-012)
DTC filed on 29 Sep 2026 to modernize the [[concepts/glossary#direct-registration-system-drs|Direct Registration System (DRS)]], which moves shares between [[concepts/glossary#cede-co|Cede & Co.]] and the holder's own name on the issuer's books; the SEC published notice on 5 Oct 2026 (Release 34-106552) ([SEC notice](https://www.federalregister.gov/documents/2026/10/05/2026-20301/self-regulatory-organizations-the-depository-trust-company-notice-of-filing-of-proposed-rule-change)). The aim is to cut processing "from days to minutes" by retiring legacy terminal and batch-file methods, offering DRS through DTC's SPA screens plus API and MQ messaging, automating the Deliver Order after a transfer agent approves a deposit, and adding status tracking and an audit trail ([SEC notice](https://www.federalregister.gov/documents/2026/10/05/2026-20301/self-regulatory-organizations-the-depository-trust-company-notice-of-filing-of-proposed-rule-change)). Only a DTC participant can start a withdrawal ([SEC notice](https://www.federalregister.gov/documents/2026/10/05/2026-20301/self-regulatory-organizations-the-depository-trust-company-notice-of-filing-of-proposed-rule-change)). DTC expects to implement on 13 Nov 2026, and no later than January 2027 ([SEC notice](https://www.federalregister.gov/documents/2026/10/05/2026-20301/self-regulatory-organizations-the-depository-trust-company-notice-of-filing-of-proposed-rule-change)).

Securitize's 25 Oct comment letter notes the filing does not mention DTC's tokenization service, and asks for a one-step burn-and-withdraw instruction, published processing times, [[concepts/glossary#dwac|DWAC]] modernization, a broker timing expectation, and a fast return to [[concepts/glossary#street-name|street name]] ([[issuers/securitize|Securitize]]; [Securitize letter](https://www.sec.gov/comments/SR-DTC-2026-012/srdtc2026012-1108719-3924407.pdf)).

## Watch
- Go-live: done, 28 Oct 2026 ([DTCC](https://www.dtcc.com/press-releases/2026/dtcc-tokenization-service-goes-live)). Next: new participants, added securities beyond the launch 34, and 2027 networks (Stellar, Arc).
- DRS modernization: confirm whether it went live 13 Nov 2026 or the later date in a DTC Important Notice, whether the SEC approved SR-DTC-2026-012, and whether DTC responds to the Securitize letter ([SEC notice](https://www.federalregister.gov/documents/2026/10/05/2026-20301/self-regulatory-organizations-the-depository-trust-company-notice-of-filing-of-proposed-rule-change)).
- First named users: 20 participants named 28 Oct 2026 (see Live). Watch for which ones actually tokenize client positions.

# Uniswap v4 permissioned pools
URL: https://edstokenizedsecuritiesrails.com/infrastructure/uniswap-permissioned-pools
description: In plain English: Uniswap's permissioned pools let only approved wallets trade a token, so regulated assets can use onchain pools.
type: infrastructure
jurisdiction: unknown
chain: unknown
status: unknown
last_updated: 2026-10-17
last_checked: 2026-10-17

> [!info] At a glance
> **Type:** infrastructure  
> **Jurisdiction:** unknown  
> **Chain:** unknown  
> **Status:** unknown  
> **Last updated:** 2026-10-17  

| Field | Value |
|---|---|
| name | Uniswap v4 permissioned pools |
| jurisdiction | unknown |
| product_name | PermissionedHooks |
| structure | Permissioned AMM hook |
| chains | unknown |
| who_can_buy | Allowlisted addresses (issuer-defined) |
| num_assets | unknown |

*In plain English: Uniswap's permissioned pools let only approved wallets trade a token, so regulated assets can use onchain pools.*

An open-source Uniswap v4 hook standard for compliant trading of tokenized [[concepts/glossary#rwa|RWAs]] and equities; issuer [[concepts/glossary#allowlist|allowlists]] are enforced on every swap and liquidity [[concepts/glossary#mint|mint]] ([Uniswap](https://blog.uniswap.org/introducing-permissioned-pools-on-uniswap-v4)).

A Permissions Adapter holds the real asset and issues a virtual token to PoolManager; PermissionedHooks checks an IAllowlistChecker ([architecture](https://developers.uniswap.org/docs/protocols/v4-hooks/permissioned-pools/architecture); [source](https://github.com/Uniswap/v4-hooks-public/blob/main/src/permissioned-pools/PermissionedHooks.sol)).

It is the [[concepts/glossary#amm-automated-market-maker|AMM]] primitive used by the first [[concepts/glossary#tsv|TSV]] notice ([[platforms-venues/okxice-tsv|OKXICE]]).

## Sources
Public originals for the facts on this page.

- <https://blog.uniswap.org/introducing-permissioned-pools-on-uniswap-v4>
- <https://developers.uniswap.org/docs/protocols/v4-hooks/permissioned-pools/architecture>
- <https://github.com/Uniswap/v4-hooks-public/blob/main/src/permissioned-pools/PermissionedHooks.sol>

*Last checked 2026-10-17. Headline fields only; `unknown` means not yet verified from a source.*

# Vertalo
URL: https://edstokenizedsecuritiesrails.com/infrastructure/vertalo
description: In plain English: Vertalo keeps companies' official shareholder records and links tokens to them, so token holders get dividends and votes.
type: infrastructure
jurisdiction: United States
chain: unknown
status: operating (platform since 2019)
last_updated: 2026-10-27
last_checked: 2026-10-27

> [!info] At a glance
> **Type:** infrastructure  
> **Jurisdiction:** United States  
> **Chain:** unknown  
> **Status:** operating (platform since 2019)  
> **Last updated:** 2026-10-27  

| Field | Value |
|---|---|
| name | Vertalo |
| jurisdiction | United States |
| product_name | Transfer agency and tokenization platform |
| structure | SEC-registered transfer agent |
| chains | unknown |
| who_can_buy | unknown |
| num_assets | unknown |

*In plain English: Vertalo keeps companies' official shareholder records and links tokens to them, so token holders get dividends and votes.*

Vertalo is an SEC-registered [[concepts/glossary#transfer-agent|transfer agent]] whose platform links tokenized securities to the shareholder records that carry a holder's dividends and votes ([Bullish](https://www.bullish.com/us/news-insights/issuer-sponsored-token-coalition-gains-momentum-as-qrt-vertalo-and-zerohash-join)). It launched its platform in 2019 and is led by founder and CEO Dave Hendricks ([Bullish](https://www.bullish.com/us/news-insights/issuer-sponsored-token-coalition-gains-momentum-as-qrt-vertalo-and-zerohash-join)).

On 26 Oct 2026 it joined the [[concepts/issuer-sponsored-token-coalition|Issuer Sponsored Token Coalition]]. Hendricks said [[concepts/glossary#issuer-sponsored-token|issuer-sponsored tokens]] work because the shareholder records and the token agree, and that this agreement drives routine [[concepts/glossary#corporate-action|corporate actions]] ([Bullish](https://www.bullish.com/us/news-insights/issuer-sponsored-token-coalition-gains-momentum-as-qrt-vertalo-and-zerohash-join)).

*Reference information only, not investment advice.*

# 2026-10-29: OKXICE objections reach 38; how issuer opt-outs work; Better Markets letter
URL: https://edstokenizedsecuritiesrails.com/changelog/2026-10-29-okxice-38-objectors-opt-out
last_checked: 2026-10-29

- OKXICE TSV: 38 issuers have objected as of its 28 Oct notice, up from 22 on 23 Oct; new names include JPMorgan, AMD, Coca-Cola, Dell, Eli Lilly and Walmart. Still no trading start date ([OKXICE notice](https://www.okx.com/cdn/assets/okfe/web3-activities/okxicetsv/notices/OKXICE_Tokenized_Securities_Venue_Public_Notice_26.10.28.pdf)).
- Innovation Exemption: issuers have 30 calendar days from a venue's notice to object, directly to that venue; opt-outs are per venue with no blanket option. Nasdaq says it intends to opt itself out of TSVs ([Nasdaq FAQ](https://www.nasdaq.com/docs/listings/faq-sec-innovation-exemption)).
- Comment file 4-927: Better Markets calls the order the biggest rewrite of equity trading rules since Reg NMS and urges the SEC to withdraw it and use notice-and-comment rulemaking ([Better Markets](https://bettermarkets.org/wp-content/uploads/2026/10/Better-Markets-Comment-Letter-SEC-Innovation-Exemption.pdf)).

# 2026-09-24: Bullish and Equiniti form the Issuer Sponsored Token Coalition
URL: https://edstokenizedsecuritiesrails.com/changelog/2026-09-24-issuer-sponsored-token-coalition
last_checked: 2026-09-24

- Bullish and Equiniti formed the [[concepts/issuer-sponsored-token-coalition|Issuer Sponsored Token Coalition]] with Alpaca, Apex Fintech Solutions and DriveWealth, a week after the SEC's [[concepts/innovation-exemption|Innovation Exemption]] ([Bullish](https://www.bullish.com/us/news-insights/leading-market-infrastructure-firms-form-coalition-to-advance-issuer-sponsored-tokenized-securities)).
- Focus: shareholder rights, interoperability, infrastructure and an open ecosystem for [[concepts/glossary#issuer-sponsored-token|issuer-sponsored tokens]].

# 2026-09-17: SEC issues the Innovation Exemption for tokenized NMS stock
URL: https://edstokenizedsecuritiesrails.com/changelog/2026-09-17-sec-innovation-exemption
last_checked: 2026-09-17

- The SEC issued an order (Rel. 34-106402) exempting Tokenized Securities Venues from the exchange definition and certain liquidity providers from the dealer definition; it expires five years after publication ([SEC](https://www.sec.gov/newsroom/press-releases/2026-90-sec-issues-innovation-exemption-facilitate-trading-tokenized-nms-stock-request-comment)).
- Published at 91 FR 60168 on 22 Sep 2026; comments go to File 4-927 ([Federal Register](https://www.federalregister.gov/documents/2026/09/22/2026-19388/order-granting-temporary-conditional-exemptive-relief-pursuant-to-section-36a1-of-the-securities)).

# 2026-09-14: UK tokenisation feedback; Robinhood plans redemption and voting
URL: https://edstokenizedsecuritiesrails.com/changelog/2026-09-14-fca-robinhood
last_checked: 2026-09-14

- FCA and Bank of England published FS26/1 on tokenisation in wholesale markets (123 responses); a joint roadmap is due later in 2026 ([FCA](https://www.fca.org.uk/publications/feedback-statements/fs26-1-tokenisation-wholesale-markets)).
- Robinhood's CEO said in-kind redemption and voting are coming for Robinhood Stock Tokens, after AMC's CEO objected to AMC tokens ([CoinDesk](https://www.coindesk.com/business/2026/09/14/robinhood-plans-share-redemptions-voting-rights-for-stock-tokens-after-criticism)).
- Coinbase's CEO said voting rights are coming to Coinbase tokenized stocks (CoinDesk).
